CERT_10_ibmRagAndAgenticAi.title: IBM RAG and Agentic AI Professional Certificate
CERT_10_ibmRagAndAgenticAi.summary: Completed eight-course professional certificate covering retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, multimodal applications, and agentic AI workflows.
CERT_10_ibmRagAndAgenticAi.curriculumNote: This record documents the original eight-course curriculum listed on the certificate awarded February 14, 2026.
CERT_10_ibmRagAndAgenticAi.takeaway: Designed context-aware generative AI systems by combining retrieval pipelines, vector databases, multimodal models, tool calling, agent memory, conditional workflows, and multi-agent orchestration.

courses.title: Develop Generative AI Applications: Get Started
courses.summary: Develops modular generative AI applications using prompt engineering, LangChain templates, chains, agents, structured outputs, Flask, and model evaluation.
courses.takeaway: Built flexible LLM applications by combining reusable LangChain components with structured prompting, model selection, and a Flask interface.

courses.title: Build RAG Applications: Get Started
courses.summary: Introduces practical RAG application development with document processing, embeddings, vector stores, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Python, and Gradio.
courses.takeaway: Connected external knowledge with LLM generation through an end-to-end retrieval pipeline and interactive application interface.

courses.title: Vector Databases for RAG: An Introduction
courses.summary: Covers vector representations, similarity search, ChromaDB collections, database operations, recommendation workflows, and internal RAG mechanisms.
courses.takeaway: Applied embeddings and similarity search to store, retrieve, and rank semantically relevant information for grounded generation.

courses.title: Advanced RAG with Vector Databases and Retrievers
courses.summary: Builds advanced retrieval pipelines using FAISS, ChromaDB, HNSW indexing, LangChain, LlamaIndex retrievers, and Gradio interfaces.
courses.takeaway: Improved retrieval quality by combining suitable vector indexes, advanced retrievers, orchestration components, and application-level evaluation.

courses.title: Build Multimodal Generative AI Applications
courses.summary: Develops applications that combine text, speech, image, and video using IBM Granite, Meta Llama, Whisper, DALL-E, Sora, Hugging Face, Flask, and Gradio.
courses.takeaway: Integrated multiple data modalities and foundation models into coherent, user-facing generative AI workflows.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Building AI Agents
courses.summary: Introduces autonomous agents, reasoning, tool calling, chaining, data-analysis agents, visualization, database queries, and agent-focused prompt engineering.
courses.takeaway: Built agents that select and use tools within structured workflows to complete analytical and application tasks.

courses.title: Agentic AI with LangChain and LangGraph
courses.summary: Builds stateful agentic systems with memory, conditional routing, iteration, Reflection, Reflexion, ReAct, collaborative agents, and Agentic RAG.
courses.takeaway: Designed stateful and self-improving agent workflows that route tasks, retain context, invoke retrieval, and coordinate reasoning steps.

courses.title: Agentic AI with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen and BeeAI
courses.summary: Compares agentic frameworks and implements structured multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI, AG2/AutoGen, BeeAI, custom tools, and conversation-driven coordination.
courses.takeaway: Selected and combined agent frameworks according to workflow state, collaboration, tool integration, and orchestration requirements.
